plainText:
Tatsuhisa Suzuki (Japanese: 鈴木達央 Suzuki Tatsuhisa) is a Japanese voice actor for . His most notable role is 's rival .

==Biography==
Suzuki was born on November 11, 1983 in Ichikawa, Chiba, Japan, but he grew up in Okazaki, Aichi, Japan. He attended Japan Narration and Acting School, and joined before graduating. His performance of an image song for the anime series got him noticed by music director Kenichirō Tsutsumi from who invited him to become a singer. A few years later, his label approached him about forming a band, and OLDCODEX was formed in 2009 after a search for potential members. Suzuki serves as the band's frontman and vocalist.

Suzuki also hosts or has hosted several radio shows including:
Mobile Cultural Broadcast A&G Suzuki Tatsuhisa Radio TIME. (モバイル文化放送A&G 鈴木達央ラジオTIME.)
Dengeki Taishou (電撃大賞)
Shuuei Academy Maiden Research Institute (集英学園乙女研究部)
BLOOD-R
